communication_expectations: Jayden is a 45-year-old professional, friendly and direct. Adult peer-level communication is expected. He is motivated and community-minded; connecting questions to his goals and roles (father, coach, athlete) works well.
caregiver_rules: Not applicable - Jayden speaks for himself.
patient_goals: Stay active with his kids, friends, and weights - 'all of the above for as long as I can'
Continue leading the after-school running program
Get wellness guidance for living with a new chronic condition

assessment_areas.case_context: Morning pain and fullness (4/10) in the small joints of both hands lasting 30-60 minutes. Timing, pattern, and impact should be characterized.
acceptable_approaches: asking when and how it hurts
asking what it stops him doing
asking how it changes through the day

assessment_areas.assessment_area: understanding of the new SLE diagnosis and his concerns
assessment_areas.case_context: Recently diagnosed systemic lupus erythematosus; his stated concern is being unable to continue his lifestyle. Exploring what he understands and worries about is central to this visit.
acceptable_approaches: open questions about what the diagnosis means to him
asking what he has been told and what concerns him

assessment_areas.case_context: Active 6 days/week 60-120 min (basketball, running, weights, gardening, playing with kids); leads a junior-high running program. His priorities should drive the plan.
acceptable_approaches: asking what he does and loves
asking what he wants to protect most

assessment_areas.assessment_area: safe activity progression with a new systemic condition
assessment_areas.case_context: With new SLE and a corticosteroid taper (Medrol, one more week), safety-relevant exploration includes how symptoms respond to activity, fatigue or systemic symptoms, and pacing - without prescribing or alarming.
acceptable_approaches: asking how his body responds after hard activity
asking about fatigue, fevers, or new symptoms
asking what happens on harder days

assessment_areas.case_context: Medrol (one more week) and Plaquenil. Reasonable to confirm and ask how they are going.
acceptable_approaches: asking about side effects in plain language

assessment_areas.case_context: Supportive husband, involved father of two, duplex garden with neighbors, volunteer coach - roles that motivate him and shape feasibility.
acceptable_approaches: asking about family and what staying active means for them

assessment_areas.case_context: Father has a history of heart disease and stroke.
About 3 fruit/vegetable servings and 4 processed servings daily (STC 8); alcohol about 4x/week, 1-2 drinks; sleep 7-8 h and good.
Child-style or caregiver-mediated questioning is not applicable to Jayden.
